checks: The same-wave construction gives the complete integer census, exposing gaps and a uniform outer coupling with ambient sum zero. Scaling all coupled continuous points by r_min keeps that sum zero and places them in every corresponding enlarged or shrunken outer cube.

At a central point a coordinate tail of at most half the central volume can be tilted to include exactly one smallest outer fiber among the outer sites. At an outer base a different exposing tilt isolates the own cube, whose exact maximum is half its volume. Together with the center lower bound these give both terms of the maximum formula for every positive radius tuple as a measured union.

The Minkowski mean of centered homothetic cubes is exactly the cube of the mean radius. Convex compatibility at zero requires that cube to lie in the central unit cube. Mean one gives the stated positive affine interpolant and therefore actual convex integer fibers.
Convexity of t↦t^d yields the denominator lower bound d+2 on the path. The central numerator drops below 3/2 and the outer numerator is bounded by exp(1/4)/2<2/3, using -log(3/4)>1/4.
